sentences.text: Di desa itu, Agus ikut warga menguburkan seorang kakek yang meninggal karena usia tua.
sentences.en: In that village, Agus joined the residents in burying an old man who died of old age.
sentences.ko: 그 마을에서 아구스는 노환으로 돌아가신 할아버지의 장례를 주민들과 함께 치렀어요.

sentences.text: Wati izin dua hari untuk menguburkan neneknya di desa.
sentences.en: Wati took two days off to bury her grandmother in her village.
sentences.ko: 와티는 고향에서 할머니 장례를 치르려고 이틀 휴가를 냈어요.

sentences.text: Agus dan Dodi bergantian mengemudikan mobil setiap tiga jam.
sentences.en: Agus and Dodi took turns driving the car every three hours.
sentences.ko: 아구스와 도디는 세 시간마다 번갈아 운전했어요.

sentences.text: Kakak Wati bekerja mengemudikan bus antarkota.
sentences.en: Wati's older brother works driving an intercity bus.
sentences.ko: 와티의 오빠는 시외버스를 운전해요.

sentences.text: Agus melihat pesawat kecil melakukan pendaratan di landasan dekat pantai.
sentences.en: Agus watched a small plane make a landing on the strip near the beach.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 작은 비행기가 해변 근처 활주로에 착륙하는 걸 봤어요.

sentences.text: Toko buku di lantai dua menjual novel tentang pendaratan manusia di bulan.
sentences.en: The bookstore on the second floor sells a novel about humans landing on the moon.
sentences.ko: 이 층 서점에서 인류의 달 착륙에 관한 소설을 팔아요.
